changelog.change: Initial 50-query benchmark, binary relevance, hand-labeled by developer. See ADR-003 and docs/design/evaluation-framework.md for known limitations.

205-query benchmark with graded relevance (grade 2 = highly relevant, grade 1 = partially relevant). 155 new queries added from pool/supplementary/throughput candidates. 18 HIGH-priority entries manually reviewed and corrected (57 false-positive notes removed from keyword-union expansion). Benchmark is now the authoritative source for Sprint 3+ gate decisions. See evaluation_results/human_review_checklist.json for review provenance.
